basic_profile.bio: A passionate gamer who recently discovered Fire Emblem and has been diving deep into the series. I enjoy strategy games and have a soft spot for character-driven narratives. Based in the Midwest, I work as a software developer and usually browse Reddit in the evenings. Currently single and often found on weekends playing games or exploring new tech gadgets.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to the Fire Emblem series, I've been learning through gameplay and community discussions. My background in computer science helps me engage with technology-related topics, and I've self-taught various programming languages over the years.
